description: UH OH. School's back in session with Mr. Deliver on an all new American Dad. Tonight at 8:30/7:30c on TBS Network.  #TBS #AmericanDad #SethMacFarlane  SUBSCRIBE: http://bit.ly/TBSSub  Download the TBS App: http://bit.ly/1qBbkMW  About American Dad: Stan Smith leads the all-American family in this animated sitcom filled with wild and crazy extremes. Everyday life is taken to the limit as Stan applies the same drastic measures used in his job at the CIA to his home-life. Driven by machismo and the American dream, he is often blind to how horribly he fails at his attempts. This father may not know best but he never stops trying! Starring Seth MacFarlane (Stan Smith, Roger), Wendy Schaal (Francine Smith), Rachael MacFarlane (Hayley Smith), Scott Grimes (Steve Smith), Dee Bradley Baker (Klaus). asr.full_text: Uh, oh! Give us a countdown! Four, three, two, one. That's right, tch. They're not gonna win us over with this. Right, guys? The music by our song To break the curse of our love Let's work together Right, guys? We're building for our signs To break the cover lines Let's work together To improve our way of life To possess and protest Discussion and justice A generation for the third To come forth with meaning You're still not teaching them anything? I taught them how to count down from four. Woah. Class dismissed.
